description: This file defines a PHP class 'ProjectActivityModel' which serves as a data model for project activity entities within the OrangeHRM Time API module. It implements serialization and normalization functionalities, and maps properties of the 'ProjectActivity' entity for API responses.

classes.name: ProjectActivityModel
classes.description: A data model class representing project activity entities for API serialization in the OrangeHRM Time module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a given ProjectActivity entity, configuring filters and attribute mappings for API output.
